== Deciding on player/clan template ==
These need to be uniform. I vote something like on [[vb]]'s article (plus any further relevent section) for players. -[[User:Lemike|Lemike]] 23:09, 29 July 2007 (CEST)
:Hmmm.... Disagreed. [[vb|vb's]] entry might look nice, but that's only because it has quite a lot of info on it. Take an entry like [[Laguanna|Laguanna's]] and turn that into an entry like [[vb|vb's]] and it will look crap imo. A player infobox with 1 single line written in it along with a huge, blank, boring white space to the left of it. The infobox sure makes sense if you look at a profile like [[Reppie|Reppie's]], but to go through the effort of converting all player-pages just for the sake of 'using infobox' - sorry dude, count me out. - [[Soma]] 23:28, 29 July 2007 (CET)
::Yep, I concur. So tidy-up the current player/clan 'templates' and save infobox'd ones for articles with extensive amounts of information, then? -[[User:Lemike|Lemike]] 08:26, 30 July 2007 (CEST)

== Map Template ==

A week or two ago I created the map template, and decided to go ahead and convert all of the popular maps to use it.  It's not quite done yet, but it's usable at least.  Please fill out the maps with stratagies and stuff.  --[[User:AlexMax|AlexMax]] 17:40, 28 December 2007 (CET)
